ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There is a blue circle in the figure, and inside the circle there is a point labeled N as the center; points A, B, C, D, E, etc. are located on the circumference. Segment AN connects from center N to point A on the circumference. Reasoning: The problem gives AN = 5 meters. Because AN is a segment from the center to the circumference, AN is the radius of circle N, that is, r = 5. The circumference formula of a circle is C = 2πr; substituting r = 5 gives C = 2π × 5 = 10π. Therefore the exact circumference of circle N is 10π meters.

raw_record.question_text: If $AN$ is 5 meters long, find the exact circumference of $\odot N$.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify \(\odot N\) as the circle with center \(N\), and observe that point \(A\) lies on the circle with segment \(AN\) drawn from the center to the circumference. From the text, take \(AN=5\) meters. Therefore \(AN\) is a radius, so use the circumference formula \(C=2\pi r\). Substitute \(r=5\) to get \(C=10\pi\) meters.
